_comment: Tools the plugin's INSTALL.md names LITERALLY in a permissions ask rule. Claude Code ask rules do NOT accept wildcards, so these must be exact. If any is renamed or removed without updating INSTALL.md, the rule stops matching SILENTLY and the tool becomes blanket-allowed. Assert every name below still exists in the tool registry; fail the build if one does not.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.why_gated: publishes a site to a real domain

tools.name: crm_estimate_send
tools.why_gated: sends an estimate to a client

tools.name: marketing_report_send
tools.why_gated: emails a report to a client

tools.name: crm_contact_email_send
tools.why_gated: sends a real email from the connected inbox, no draft or recall

tools.name: crm_enroll_sequence
tools.why_gated: enrolling into an active sequence queues real email

tools.name: crm_sequence_enroll_bulk
tools.why_gated: bulk-enrolls into an active sequence - real email at batch scale

tools.name: email_sequence_enroll
tools.why_gated: enrolls real recipients into a drip that sends on a schedule

tools.name: email_sequence_activate
tools.why_gated: turns a drip on - every enrollment starts sending

tools.name: voice_sms_send
tools.why_gated: sends a real SMS, no draft or recall

tools.name: voice_sms_send_to_contact
tools.why_gated: sends a real SMS to a CRM contact

tools.name: voice_sms_thread_reply
tools.why_gated: sends a real SMS reply into a live thread

tools.name: outbound_campaign_status_set
tools.why_gated: starts or stops cold-email sending for a whole campaign (PAUSED executes with no confirm step)

tools.name: outbound_campaign_sequences_save
tools.why_gated: full-replaces the campaign's steps on the provider - on an ACTIVE campaign that is the live sending copy

tools.name: outbound_reply_draft_send
tools.why_gated: emails a prospect - sends a saved draft as a real reply through the provider
